purpose: Neutral sword slash unwrapped RGBA ribbon candidates

prompts.name: A 清晰银线
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral sword-slash RIBBON texture for a 3D fantasy action game. Generate ONE isolated straight horizontal luminous trail strip on genuinely transparent RGBA background. It is an UNWRAPPED texture, NOT a curved crescent, not a weapon, not a whole scene. Entire strip fully inside canvas, extending horizontally left-to-right, sharp ivory/silver-white core, softer edges, zero elemental symbols, no fire/ice/lightning, no text, no watermark. Fully transparent exterior, no checkerboard baked in. Long slim shape centered in wide landscape image, original texture detail suitable for sampling on a swept sword ribbon mesh. Restrained high quality stylized fantasy, silhouette readable at small scale. Variant A: a single clean elegant thin silver-white ribbon, continuous smooth luminous core, gentle translucent soft falloff, little texture, needle-tapered at both ends. Quiet precise normal sword attack, no sparks included.
